basic_info.name: Shikho
basic_info.description: Shikho is building AI-native human capital infrastructure for Bangladesh and emerging markets.We started in education because access to high-quality learning remains one of the largest structural bottlenecks across developing economies. But our long-term vision goes far beyond “edtech.”We believe the defining challenge for emerging markets over the next two decades will be how countries develop productive, adaptable, AI-ready populations at scale.Bangladesh alone has more than 85 million people under the age of 25. The ambition and talent exists. The challenge is scalable access to high-quality learning, teachers, infrastructure, and opportunity.Shikho was built to help close that gap.Today, Shikho is one of Bangladesh’s largest learning platforms, serving millions of learners across all 64 districts through:* live classes* recorded and animated lessons* assessments and analytics* AI-powered learning tools* QR-linked physical textbooks* connected learning devices* personalized learning workflowsOur platform combines structured curriculum systems, behavioral learning data, assessments, and embedded AI to create deeply personalized educational experiences designed for Bangla-medium learners at scale.But we increasingly see education as only the first layer.We are building systems across:* learning* teacher enablement* analytics* AI infrastructure* workforce readiness* learning-to-earning pathwaysOur belief is simple:the future of education is not replacing teachers with AI.It is empowering both teachers and learners with intelligent infrastructure that helps them perform at a dramatically higher level.Today, Shikho serves over 4 million registered learners, the majority from outside major metropolitan areas, helping scale access to high-quality learning beyond traditional geographic and socioeconomic barriers.We are building for one of the youngest populations in the world — and for the future of human capital in the AI era.

basic_info.name: Medco E&P Indonesia
basic_info.description: Medco E&P Indonesia, a subsidiary of Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, is dedicated to oil and gas operations in Indonesia, with a focus on upstream activities such as exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. The company manages a total of 15 oil and gas assets in Indonesia, of which 12 are currently in production. In 2023, these assets exceeded production targets, contributing 143 mboepd. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards and best practices throughout our operations.We continue to make progress on our ESG commitments. In 2023, we have implemented 41 GHG emission reduction initiatives through process optimization, fuel gas reduction, reducing fugitive emissions, and improving energy efficiency with lighting replacement and solar PV installation, such as in Matak (150 kWp) and Bronang Platform (11.5 kWp). These initiatives resulted in a reduction of 147,963 tCO2e/year, with a one-time reduction of 94,860 tCO2e from well cleanup & testing flare reduction. We are currently progressing CCS studies at the Natuna, Corridor and South Sumatera PSCs. We also planted 143,883 trees across our sites, and committed to their maintenance.

basic_info.name: Zipline
basic_info.description: Zipline was founded to create the first logistics system that serves all humans equally. Our aim is to solve the world’s most urgent and complex access challenges. Leveraging expertise in robotics and autonomy, Zipline designs, manufactures and operates the world’s largest automated delivery system. Zipline serves tens of millions of people around the world and is making good on the promise of building an equitable and more resilient global supply chain.  From powering Rwanda’s national blood delivery network and Ghana’s COVID-19 vaccine distribution, to providing on-demand home delivery for Walmart and enabling leading healthcare providers to bring care into the home in the United States, Zipline is transforming the way goods move. By transitioning to clean, electric, instant logistics, we can decarbonize delivery, decrease road congestion, and reduce fossil fuel consumption and air pollution, while providing equitable access for billions of people. The technology is complex but the idea is simple: a teleportation service that delivers what you need, when you need it.  Zipline is inspiring people, governments, and businesses to imagine what is possible when goods can move as seamlessly as information.To join the team, check out our career page: https://flyzipline.com/careers/
